Today’s failing approach: competency reviews rely on ratings and inference
how_to_reg
Self-assessment
Employees choose their own level on the competency matrix. The rating records their view of their ability without producing a task output to review.
supervisor_account
Manager ratings
Different managers can apply the same level definitions differently. Your people team then has no shared measure when it compares teams.
cloud
Inferred skills
An HR skills cloud infers skills from profile and system data. The result can identify a potential gap without confirming the skill through a scored task.
Your people team is left comparing ratings and inferred data when it makes staffing or development decisions.
Competency assessment software for business roles and engineering teams
Codility Skills Intelligence is competency assessment software for the employees you already have.
groups

Questions about competency assessment software
Competency assessment software measures employees’ skills against defined proficiency levels or role standards. Codility Skills Intelligence scores the output that employees in business roles and engineers produce on realistic tasks.
Common competency assessment tools include self-assessments, manager reviews, 360-degree feedback and skills tests. Codility Skills Intelligence adds work simulations and coding tasks, then scores each submitted output.
Codility covers two areas. For business roles, AI for Business measures how employees work with AI. Employees write prompts, check responses for errors and decide when to override AI output. For engineering teams, a technical competency assessment covers software engineering skills including backend, web, mobile, databases, data, cloud and DevOps.
No. Engineers receive a proficiency level for each assessed skill, on a five-level scale from novice to expert. Employees in business roles receive a score on each submitted output.
An employee competency assessment in Skills Intelligence records the task output and its score. A self-assessment records the employee’s own rating. Your people team can review the submitted output behind a Skills Intelligence result.
